split.note: Each share becomes a part payment on this order.
move.hint: Pick what moves. The new order keeps the same server and table. Payments already taken stay on this order.
move.button_one: Move {count} item to a new order
move.button_other: Move {count} items to a new order
move.keepOne: Leave at least one item on this order.
move.paidTooMuch: {paid} is already paid on this order, so at least that much has to stay.
sync.review.priceMismatch: {product} was sold at {recorded} while offline, but an admin had changed the price to {server}. The sale is kept as recorded.
sync.review.archivedProduct: {product} was sold after it was taken off the menu. The sale is kept as recorded.
sync.review.revokedDevice: This phone was removed from Kaunta, so this was kept aside for an admin.
sync.review.other: The server kept this but could not apply it.
pair.title: Connect this phone
pair.body: Ask an admin for a 6-digit pairing code from Staff & devices, then type it here.
pair.invalid: That code didn’t work. Check it, or ask for a new one.
pair.tooMany: Too many wrong codes. Wait 10 minutes and try again.
pair.offline: Connect to the internet to pair this phone.
pair.loading: Connected. Getting the menu and staff list…
pair.failed: Couldn’t reach the server. Check the internet and try again.
